projectInfo.name: Unity VR Light Tunnel Project
projectInfo.primaryUse: VR room with light tunnel effects

lightTunnel.description: Tunnel with half-sphere lights and cylinders for neon tube lighting
lightTunnel.orientation: Strips arranged front-to-back, lights within strips arranged left-to-right

spatialLayout.example: Light 6 = left side near top, Light 16 = right side third from bottom

neonTubes.spatialLayout: Left to right (MRAN_1 = bottom left, MRAN_17 = bottom right)

properties._UnlitColor: Color for unlit mode if used
properties._UseEmissiveIntensity: Flag to enable intensity control (set to 1)

keywords._EMISSION: Must be enabled for emission to work

importantAttributes.ExecuteAlways: REQUIRED for Edit mode functionality - script will not run in Edit mode without this
importantAttributes.CustomEditor: Used for custom inspector buttons (Preview, Stop, Reset)

editModeRequirements.cleanup: Must unsubscribe from EditorApplication.update in OnDestroy/OnDisable

development.workingStyle: One focused task per context window to avoid file confusion

testing.reason: Faster iteration without entering Play mode

agents.purpose: Catch compilation errors, duplicate methods, Unity anti-patterns before commit

StripLightController.cs.purpose: Sequential strip lighting controller with Edit mode preview
features: HDR color control with separate emission intensity
Memory leak prevention (material cleanup in OnDestroy)
requirements: Must be attached to VR_Room GameObject

features: Status indicator when preview is running

LaserController.cs.purpose: Comprehensive club-style laser system with line beams and fan effects
LaserController.cs.status: PARTIALLY WORKING - needs custom shader to be fully functional
features: Two laser types: Line (straight beams) and Fan (expanding fan pattern)
Line beams use LineRenderer with world space coordinates
Fan beams use procedural mesh generation
Three animation modes: None, Rotation (sweeping), Circle (tip traces circle)
Edit mode preview with animation support
HDR color control with emission intensity

LineRenderer.useWorldSpace: MUST be true - positions are absolute world coordinates
LineRenderer.alignment: LineAlignment.View - makes laser visible from all angles (billboard effect)

coordinates.originPosition: World space position where laser starts
coordinates.circleCenter: World space position where circle is drawn
coordinates.noRelativeCoordinates: Everything is absolute, no parent-relative offsets

knownIssues: CRITICAL: Material MUST use MirzaConverted custom shader, NOT HDRP/Lit
HDRP/Lit shader doesn't have custom properties (_ColourA, _RadialMaskRadius, etc.)
Emission Intensity only works with custom shader properties
Radial Mask only works with custom shader keywords
Noise only works with custom shader
Vertical Color only works with custom shader
Alpha transparency requires material in Transparent mode
User needs to either: use existing MirzaConverted material OR create simplified custom shader

inspectorOrganization.clarity: Clearly labeled what works for Line vs Fan vs Both

requirements: Material with MirzaConverted shader (or equivalent custom shader)

features: Clear All Lasers button with confirmation dialog
Status indicator when preview is running

SimpleLineTest.cs.purpose: Debug script for testing LineRenderer coordinate space
SimpleLineTest.cs.status: DEBUG TOOL - used to verify world space coordinates work correctly
features: Draws line from startPoint to endPoint in world space
Shows gizmo spheres at start (green) and end (red) points
Helped identify that useWorldSpace=true was the solution
SimpleLineTest.cs.note: Can be deleted if not needed, was just for debugging coordinate issues

criticalMistakes.impact: Script wouldn't run in Edit mode at all
criticalMistakes.solution: Always add [ExecuteAlways] for Edit mode scripts

criticalMistakes.issue: Used Standard shader properties (_Color, _EmissionColor) instead of HDRP properties
criticalMistakes.impact: Lights wouldn't change color or emit
criticalMistakes.solution: Use _BaseColor and _EmissiveColor for HDRP Lit materials

criticalMistakes.impact: Material memory leak in Play mode builds
criticalMistakes.solution: Move material cleanup outside editor-only blocks

criticalMistakes.issue: Used GetComponentsInChildren instead of explicit light names
criticalMistakes.impact: Might grab wrong objects or miss specific lights
criticalMistakes.solution: Explicitly find lights by their naming convention

criticalMistakes.issue: LineRenderer local space coordinates - originPosition moved GameObject instead of line start point
criticalMistakes.impact: Laser start point was stuck at world (0,0,0), user couldn't position it
criticalMistakes.solution: Set lineRenderer.useWorldSpace = true, then all positions are absolute world coordinates

criticalMistakes.issue: Assumed HDRP/Lit shader would work with custom properties
criticalMistakes.impact: NONE of the laser effects worked - no emission control, no radial mask, no noise
criticalMistakes.solution: MUST use material with MirzaConverted custom shader OR create custom shader with needed properties

criticalMistakes.issue: LineRenderer alignment was TransformZ which prevented visibility from all angles
criticalMistakes.impact: Laser only visible from behind, not from front
criticalMistakes.solution: Use LineAlignment.View for billboard effect - always faces camera

criticalMistakes.issue: OnValidate() caused beam type switching to not work properly
criticalMistakes.impact: Switching from Line to Fan during preview left old renderer component
criticalMistakes.solution: Check if beam type changed and destroy/recreate beam object with correct components

bestPractices: Always check material properties match the shader being used
Material instancing must be cleaned up in OnDestroy
Use specific object names rather than generic queries
Test in Edit mode with preview functionality before Play mode
Let agents review code before committing
For LineRenderer: always set useWorldSpace explicitly (true or false depending on needs)
Test coordinate space early with simple debug scripts before building complex systems
When setting shader properties, verify shader actually HAS those properties
Enable shader keywords when using features (_VERTICALCOLOUR_ON, _RADIALMASKSUBTRACTIVE_ON, etc.)
Organize inspector with clear headers showing what's for Line vs Fan vs Both
Use OnValidate() for real-time inspector updates in Edit mode

lightTunnel: Additional lighting effects beyond sequential strips

Add 'drawing' effect - project circle/decal where laser tip hits
Raycast to detect surface intersections for realistic projections
Figure-8, spiral, and other custom motion paths
Sine wave oscillation on laser parameters (breathing, wobbling)
